name: Azure Cosmos DB Pattern
summary: Builds and operates Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL access patterns (partitioning, indexing, consistency, transactions, change feed, vectors, RBAC, encryption, backup and restore, provisioning) as proposals gated on user approval, citing a per-claim evidence ledger.
security_notes: Static by default. Produces code, IaC and CLI as proposals; never runs writes, deployment, backfill, deletion, restore, feature changes or load tests without confirmed target, blast radius, rollback and user approval. Never requests credentials or prints customer data.
